scenarios.title: Join the configured YouGile API host and request path correctly
scenarios.task: Treat this text as the complete canonical implementation task. Fix URL construction in src/common/request-helper.ts. The default host and a custom YOUGILE_API_HOST_URL must work whether the host has a trailing slash or not, and callers must work whether path has a leading slash or not. The boundary must contain exactly one slash while the rest of the host, path, and query string remains unchanged. Export a small pure function named buildYougileApiUrl(hostUrl, requestPath) from that module and use it in makeYougileRequest so an independent test can exercise the behavior without making a network request. Preserve the existing makeYougileRequest API, authentication, logging, request, response, and error behavior. Do not add dependencies or change package manifests. Keep the change scoped to this task and run npm run build.
required_behaviors: host without trailing slash plus path without leading slash
host with trailing slash plus path without leading slash
host without trailing slash plus path with leading slash
host with trailing slash plus path with leading slash

scenarios.title: Fail closed and uniformly for malformed safe-mode ciphertext
scenarios.task: Treat this text as the complete canonical implementation task. Harden safe-mode Decrypt in go/encrypt.go. Malformed safe encoding, a truncated envelope (including salt plus nonce but no GCM authentication tag), a wrong key, and a tampered ciphertext must never panic and must all return an error whose exact text is invalid ciphertext. A valid safe-mode round trip must still work. Preserve shell mode behavior, public function signatures, PBKDF2 parameters, and the encoded envelope format. Do not add dependencies or change go.mod/go.sum. Add focused table-driven regression coverage and run go test -skip OpenSSL ./... from the go directory; the existing external-OpenSSL interoperability tests are excluded only because the pinned benchmark host does not expose openssl on PATH. Keep the change scoped to this task; do not redesign the encryption package.
required_behaviors: malformed safe encoding returns invalid ciphertext
truncated safe envelope returns invalid ciphertext without panic
missing GCM tag returns invalid ciphertext without panic
valid safe-mode round trip remains unchanged

scenarios.title: Format integer-backed Laravel prices without floating-point precision loss
scenarios.task: Treat this text as the complete canonical implementation task. Fix string rendering in src/Support/ValueObjects/Price.php so raw integer minor units are formatted exactly without passing them through floating-point arithmetic. Treat precision as a decimal scale: support positive powers of ten such as 1, 10, 100, and 1000, render exactly the corresponding number of fractional digits, group whole digits with spaces, use a comma decimal separator, and retain the existing currency symbol. With the default precision, raw 9007199254740993 must render with the numeric part 90 071 992 547 409,93 and PHP_INT_MAX on a 64-bit runtime must render as 92 233 720 368 547 758,07; ordinary values and zero must remain correct. Reject a non-positive precision or a precision that is not a power of ten with InvalidArgumentException whose exact message is Precision must be a positive power of ten. Preserve the public constructor and method signatures, the existing currency validation, raw(), and value() behavior for existing normal inputs. Do not add dependencies or change composer.json, composer.lock, package.json, or package-lock.json. Add focused unit regression coverage, run php -l src/Support/ValueObjects/Price.php, and keep the change scoped to the value object and its tests; do not introduce a money package, service layer, cast redesign, or framework-wide abstraction.
required_behaviors: large raw integer formatting has no floating-point precision loss
PHP_INT_MAX formats exactly on a 64-bit runtime
whole digits are grouped with spaces and the decimal separator is a comma
zero and ordinary default-precision prices remain unchanged
invalid precision is rejected with the canonical exception
